newsitem.title: USA: Cable & Wireless restructures Caribbean rates.
newsitem.headline: Cable & Wireless restructures Caribbean rates.

text.p: Cable & Wireless said Tuesday that it plans to increase rental and local calling rates in 14 Caribbean countries over the next four years, while lowering the cost of international calls in the region by an average of 50 percent.
Cable & Wireless said it was seeking to balance prices more closely to reflect the associated costs of the different types of service.
The company, which is the third largest carrier of international traffic in the world, added that it has invested over one billion dollars in the Caribbean over the past five years.
No further information was available concerning the extent of the planned increases.
